## Save what decides eligibility

Grant eligibility turns on facts this project does not otherwise hold:
entity type, state, headcount, turnover, years trading.

This saves one row. A field left blank keeps whatever was saved before,
so the owner can correct one detail without repeating all of them.

It saves only what the user actually said. Anything the agent guesses
produces a wrong verdict every time it runs until somebody notices.
